answer: At the trading wharf, each agent identity locks a refundable 45 POA bond for 21 days before it can act, and one bond covers exactly one identity, so a farm cannot split one deposit across accounts. Randomly assigned auditors check the live signal that the bond is still locked before any trade clears. An identity caught trading without a valid lock loses the full 45 POA and is barred from re-registering. A grove of fakes would each need a fresh 45 POA lock, so forgery pays full price every time.
